CustomField.description: Formula field to auto populate IMSight number based on Source System, Owning District, Customer Id
CustomField.formula: CASE( Source_System__c , 'Netsuite','DIGI', 'SB NA','25', 'Jaguar', '26', 'SKP NA', '15', 'ESS', 'ESS', 'GDS', 'GDS', 'TOBAS', 'TOBAS', 'SKP Europe' , 'SKPE', 'ARCVMS Europe', 'ARVE', 'Other Europe', 'OTHE', 'IMAPIS', 'IMAP', 'SB IMLA', 'SBLA', 'SKP IMLA', 'SKPL', 'Other IMLA', 'OTHL', 'Documenta COL', 'DOCO', 'Error: Unknown Source System Code' ) & "." & IM_District_Branch_Id__c & "." & Name
CustomField.label: IMSight Number
